source_convention_map.source: Alcubierre et al., arXiv:2103.15012 equations (20)-(33), specialized to ell=0
exact_background_checks: the mapped KG and lapse equations agree identically
source_convention_map.ground_state_requirement: sigma(r)>0 for every finite r and has the certified positive factored tail, so logarithmic derivatives are used only with a nonzero denominator enclosure

exact_operator.coefficient_reduction: all derivatives and apparent 1/r or sigma denominators are evaluated through the certified origin parity, background ODE and factored-tail identities; point sampling or removable-singularity division is forbidden

self_adjoint_domain.realization: the Friedrichs realization generated by the closure of q on C_c^infinity((0,infinity);R^2)
self_adjoint_domain.origin_regular_rates_ell0: v1=O(r), v2=O(r^2); the singular alternatives v1=O(1), v2=O(r^-1) are excluded
self_adjoint_domain.infinity: v belongs to L2(dr;R^2), has finite form norm and the Lagrange boundary form p*(v'^T*u-v^T*u') vanishes
self_adjoint_domain.coefficient_duties: p has a strictly positive global lower ball, the origin inverse-square coefficient is alpha_c^2*diag(0,2), and all remaining potential terms have directed locally integrable bounds
self_adjoint_domain.domain_authority: a finite-radius Dirichlet wall, sampled decay check or unspecified self-adjoint extension is forbidden

endpoint_and_essential_spectrum.origin_product: the origin cell supplies even Taylor models plus explicit remainders for alpha,b,sigma and the regularized V,Q,W coefficients through the derivative order consumed by the verifier

tail_limits.remainder: W-W_infinity=O(1/r), with first derivative O(1/r^2), all as outward balls from the full factored tail

endpoint_and_essential_spectrum.free_dispersion: the two co-rotating asymptotic branches are (sqrt(k^2+1)-omega)^2 and (sqrt(k^2+1)+omega)^2
endpoint_and_essential_spectrum.proof_duty: certify 0<omega<1, the stated p/theta_prime/W limits and relative compactness of the vanishing coefficient remainders with respect to the constant-coefficient form; Weyl stability then gives spectrum_essential(H_T)=[E_ess,infinity)

strict_lower_certificate.certificate_scalar: L is an exact positive dyadic rational
strict_lower_certificate.certificate_field: S(r)=R(r)^T*K(r)*R(r), where K=K^T has three exact-dyadic piecewise-polynomial/factored-tail components on the frozen 256-cell origin/bulk/infinity cover; interval balls enclose evaluation, not the stored certificate coefficients
strict_lower_certificate.cell_condition: on every complete closed cell, directed interval-polynomial bounds first prove the C12-C21 identity under the R2 identity rule and then prove C_L positive definite by C11_lower>0 and det(C_L)_lower>0
strict_lower_certificate.internal_jump: at every cell boundary r_i, the exact dyadic matrix D_i=K_left(r_i)-K_right(r_i) is positive semidefinite by exact rational principal-minor tests; because p(r_i)>0, B_i=p(r_i)*D_i is positive semidefinite. An undecidable interval jump is forbidden
strict_lower_certificate.origin_boundary: r*K is bounded and the regular v rates make lim_(r->0) v^T*S*v=0
strict_lower_certificate.infinity_boundary: K is uniformly bounded in the factored q=1/r representation and every form-domain trace has vanishing terminal boundary contribution
strict_lower_certificate.identity: q[v]-L*||v||_L2^2=sum_cells integral p*|v'-S*v|^2+sum_cells integral v^T*R^T*C_L*R*v+sum_internal v(r_i)^T*R(r_i)^T*B_i*R(r_i)*v(r_i)
strict_lower_certificate.conclusion: H_T>=L*I in quadratic-form sense, including exclusion of zero and all spectrum below L
strict_lower_certificate.builder_rule: each lane may construct a different valid K, but its deterministic builder, degrees, iteration counts, rational projection, work budget and failure behavior are source-hash-bound before any scientific ingress

fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.trial: a nonzero compactly supported co-rotating two-vector w_trial with exact dyadic piecewise-polynomial coefficients, w_trial(0)=0 and exact intercell continuity
fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.evaluation: directed ball integration of integral (p*|w_trial'-theta_prime*J*w_trial|^2+w_trial^T*W*w_trial) divided by integral |w_trial|^2
fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.upper_ball: U_ball outwardly encloses the Rayleigh quotient and U=upper(U_ball)
fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.existence_conclusion: the min-max principle and U<E_ess force a discrete lowest radial eigenvalue chi0_squared with L<=chi0_squared<=U
fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.stability_conclusion: strict L>0 proves the fundamental radial mode is oscillatory and excludes exponentially growing spherical linear modes in the frozen perturbation sector
fundamental_mode_upper_certificate.nonclaims: this does not prove nonspherical, nonlinear, apparatus, propulsion or transport stability

mass_turning_side_comparator.observable: the common geometrized mass intersection from the mass-observable contract, evaluated as a function of the frozen lambda continuation
mass_turning_side_comparator.cell_duty: on every Lambda_i, i=0..1023, implicit differentiation of the validated continuation tube and the mass functional gives one outward ball for dM/dlambda with strictly positive lower endpoint
mass_turning_side_comparator.conclusion: with lambda_turn=inf{lambda>0:dM/dlambda=0} and inf(empty)=+infinity, the cell proof gives lambda_turn>1; hence the selected endpoint lambda=1 is on the pre-first-turning side of the covered ground-state branch
mass_turning_side_comparator.separation_of_authority: this comparator is mandatory for the first clause of R2-C13 but cannot replace either spectral certificate

chronology_and_record_abi.construction_freeze: both producer-specific K and trial builders, degrees, exact projections, search bounds and work budgets are persisted and self-hashed before selected-background ingress
required_record_fields: K certificate and every cell/jump margin
chronology_and_record_abi.cross_lane_agreement: the primary and independent [L,U] balls overlap, their E_ess balls overlap and both independently pass every strict predicate; K and trial coefficients need not agree
chronology_and_record_abi.first_failure: the earliest failing role terminates the lane; retry, retune, smoothing, deletion and alternate output roots are forbidden
